[b]RESOURCE UTILISATION ACT ~ Erene RP
[/b]
[i]The Resource Utilisation Act hereby declares that all natural resources, within the borders and EEZ of Pantagruel, belong to the State itself. An estimated $60B will be invested into the resource harvestment sector, mainly focusing on the development of harvesting and refining equipment. Along with that, three new aluminum and oil refineries are to be developed in central Pantagruel. This will see steep development in national industrial capacity, generate tens of thousands of new jobs, and reduce dependency on foreign imports. Revenues derived from these sectors shall be directed into the National Development Fund, ensuring long-term reinvestment into infrastructure, education, and defense. All projects will be conducted under strict observation, to ensure no corruption takes place in between development. 

Additionally, all active offshore rigs within the Pantagrueli will see a 15B$ investment into modernizing equipment, while also increasing salaries for workers in the fossil fuel industry. All funding will come directly from the pockets off the government, and also from the bloated military spending. If succesful, Pantagruel will be able to utilise 15% of its total natural resources, a large difference than the former 3%.

[/i]
